modern: It is no evil for things to undergo change, and no good for things to exist as a result of change.
original: It is no evil for things to undergo change, and no good for things to subsist in consequence of change.

explained.summary: Change is neither bad nor good. It’s no evil for things to be broken down, and no great good for things to be made. Marcus is evening out our feelings: we mourn endings and celebrate beginnings, but they’re the same process seen from different ends.
